args.body:
File: src/api/reports.ts

Truncate the source report's name to fit within MAX_NAME_LENGTH minus the length of ' (copy)' before appending the suffix, ensuring that the '(copy)' label is never truncated or removed when duplicating a report with a maximum-length name.

This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

When duplicating a report, src/api/reports.ts truncates the duplicated name using truncate(`${source.name} (copy)`, MAX_NAME_LENGTH) instead of truncating source.name first, which causes '(copy)' to be lost if the source name is already at MAX_NAME_LENGTH.

args.body:
File: src/util/strings.ts

Update the slugify implementation in src/util/strings.ts to preserve non-Latin characters (such as Greek and Cyrillic) instead of stripping them out with a restrictive ASCII-only regular expression.

args.title: Clarify handling of currencies without minor units in parseAmount

result: {"pull_request": "pr-75", "branch": "repomind/issue-4426", "state": "open"}

args.body:
label: question
file: src/util/money.ts
This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

Transaction amounts are stored as exact integer minor units (bigint) in the database via parseAmount in src/util/money.ts, avoiding floating point rounding errors. Currencies without minor units (such as JPY, KRW, CLP, ISK, VND, XAF, XOF) use 0 decimal digits and are stored as whole units.
